# PreparedMenu

Namespace `Nfty.Ticket` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public sealed class PreparedMenu
```

A Menu with its draw order and running weight totals already resolved.

## Remarks

The same split [`WeightedRoller.Prepare()`](Nfty.Core.Generation.WeightedRoller.md#m-prepare-system-collections-generic-ireadonlydictionary-2d4b54) makes, for the same reason: the ordering and the totals are fixed properties of the book, and a server rolling thousands of drops a second must not re-sort and re-sum on every one.
